remarks: Fantastic EAST NORWALK Condo with $10,000 CREDIT @closing! New construction completed in 2022. Largest unit in the complex. Fantastic opportunity to secure this lightly lived in modern turn-key three bedroom 3 1/2 bath two car attached garage w/electric charger townhouse. This open floor plan features a large gourmet kitchen with luxury appliances, stunning tile and Quartz with an attached family room combo, perfect for entertaining, relaxing by the gas fireplace or sitting outside on the balcony perfect for your morning cup of coffee! Classic & clean design throughout with tall ceilings, oversized windows and white oak wood floors. This stunning townhouse lives like a spacious house, but has low maintenance with energy saving materials and with low HOA's $425 per month. Pull into your private two car garage & enter into a mudroom/storage area. Continue to 3 generous floors of living. Arrive at the 1st floor with an in unit washer and dryer, half bath and stunning Dining/great room/kitchen combo that everyone is looking for! The 2nd Floor has a large primary bedroom with closets and an ensuite luxury bath. Across the hall an additional private bedroom with ensuite spa bath. 3rd floor additional bedroom or flex space with large ensuite bathroom and additional storage. Get into one of the best kept secrets of Norwalk-East Norwalk, where you can surround yourself by Calf Pasture beach, delicious Restaurants in East Norwalk nearby train station,SONO & Westport at your fingertips
